title: Nile Expedition
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Nile Expedition", at revision 1381628255, opens: "The Nile Expedition, sometimes called the Gordon Relief Expedition (1884–1885), was a British mission to relieve Major-General Charles George Gordon at Khartoum, Sudan. Gordon had been sent to Sudan to help the Egyptians withdraw their garrisons after the British decided to abandon Sudan in the face of a rebellion led by self-proclaimed Mahdi, Mahommed Ahmed. A contingent of Canadians was recruited to help the British navigate their small boats up the Nile River. The Nile Expedition was the first overseas expedition by Canadians in a British imperial conflict, although the Nile Voyageurs were civilian employees and did not wear uniforms." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q262584, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Failed rescue mission". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
